visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black graphic t-shirt and grey ripped jeans is seen in a cluttered living room environment. He is wearing a black face mask and has dark, messy hair. He is carefully arranging numerous green and yellow tea cartons on a grey sofa and the floor. The background includes anime figurines, various bags, and a bright white wall with a framed picture. (2) The man stands and initiates a domino-style chain reaction by tipping the first carton on the sofa. He moves with quick steps and crouches to ensure the line of falling cartons remains continuous as it moves from the sofa to the wooden floor. The lighting is bright and typical of an indoor home setting. (3) The sequence continues across the floor and onto a low wooden coffee table. He follows the movement closely, his hands gesturing toward the falling items. Many more cartons are visible in the background, some in plastic bags, indicating a large-scale setup. The camera uses handheld movements to track the action. (4) In the final phase, the last set of cartons falls near a ring light setup. The man stands up tall, raises his arms in a victory pose, and gives two thumbs up directly to the camera with an energetic expression. A bright white ring light and some filming equipment are visible in the background as the celebration concludes.
